pack.name: Gate of the Guardians
pack.blurb: Sanga, Kazejin and Suijin, the three who stand at the gate, and the Gate Guardians they become. With them, the weapon Guardians who can only take the field once their own weapon is on it.

deck.name: Gate of the Guardians
deck.blurb: Thunder, wind and water hold the line until the three of them fuse into a Gate Guardian. Dark Element calls up the darkest one, and Guardian Eatos swings her sword between them.

new_duel.intro: Nobody gets past the gate. Not today.

lines: KaibaCorp Tower. The lobby is open to duelists during the tournament.
The elevators are not. And if you want past me, you go through three of my guardians first.
